title: Term Life Insurance Product Specifications: Issue Ages, Face Limits and Coverage Period
content:
Term Life Insurance is issued in six tiers. Each tier is issued only within its own issue ages (age last birthday of the insured on the issue date) and face limits, and every tier is underwritten on full medical evidence with an owner who has an insurable interest in the insured.

| | Ashgrove Annual Renewable Term | Ashgrove Level Term 10 | Ashgrove Level Term 15 | Ashgrove Level Term 20 | Ashgrove Level Term 25 | Ashgrove Level Term 30 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Premium guarantee period (years from the issue date) | 1 | 10 | 15 | 20 | 25 | 30 |
| Lowest issue age | 18 | 18 | 18 | 18 | 18 | 18 |
| Highest issue age | 70 | 75 | 70 | 65 | 55 | 50 |
| Smallest face amount (USD) | 50000 | 100000 | 100000 | 100000 | 100000 | 100000 |
| Largest face amount on one policy (USD) | 5000000 | 10000000 | 10000000 | 10000000 | 10000000 | 10000000 |
| Attained age at the anniversary on which coverage ends | 95 | 95 | 95 | 95 | 95 | 95 |
| Underwriting | full medical | full medical | full medical | full medical | full medical | full medical |
| Owner's insurable interest required | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |

### Notes to the schedule

- A premium guarantee period of 1 year means the premium of the Ashgrove Annual Renewable Term is re-set on every policy anniversary; the level term tiers hold their rate for the number of years shown.
- The smallest face amount is also the floor below which a face decrease or a partial conversion may not leave the term coverage.
- Example (hypothetical): an insured aged 60 last birthday on the issue date falls inside the issue ages of the Ashgrove Level Term 10 (18 to 75) and the Ashgrove Level Term 15 (18 to 70), and outside those of the Ashgrove Level Term 25 (18 to 55) and the Ashgrove Level Term 30 (18 to 50).
